prompt:
Subject: 
Cheek layered with ocean scenery

Main Figure:
A multiple exposure portrait of a young woman sitting by a bright window in profile, with black window frames, white curtains, the sea surface, and shadows of branches semi-transparently layered over her face. The head and upper body are placed large in the center of the frame, with bent knees in the lower left, concentrating the layering of the ocean scene from the right side of the face to the shoulder.

Character/Expression:
A profile with a slender oval face and a small round chin, extending the neck and tilting the face upwards to the left. The visible long eye is half-open looking upward, with pale eyebrows, a straight high bridge of the nose, and plump beige-pink glossy lips slightly parted. A quiet expression with light skin and pale eye makeup. Long chestnut hair is parted near the center, with thin wet-looking strands along the forehead, cheeks, neck, and chest.

Clothing/Pose:
A soft white dress with thin shoulder straps layered with a semi-transparent white long-sleeved sheer material. Sheer fabric follows the arm from the right shoulder, with fine gathers at the cuffs. Sitting by the window leaning the upper body to the right, stretching the chest and neck to raise the chin, with bent knees forming a large foreground in the lower left.

Background/Light:
The base background is a high-brightness interior melting from white to light gray. The right half of the screen overlays black vertical and horizontal window frames, white curtains catching the wind, a blue-gray sea with a horizon, a white shimmering water surface, and silhouettes of dark twigs and leaves. Warm and soft backlighting from the upper right outlines the forehead, nose tip, cheeks, chin, and neck, making the sea surface reflections sparkle granularly.

Composition/Camera:
2:3 aspect ratio. Camera pointed horizontally from a height close to the sitting person's chest, capturing a close-up portrait from the crown of the head to the upper body and the lower left knee. Profile placed in the upper center-left, with a pale plain margin on the upper left and window frames/ocean scenery layered on the right half. Focused on the facial contour and eyelashes, the two images blend in transparent gradations without hard boundaries.

Texture/Style:
A delicate high-definition photorealistic photo in multiple exposure based on white and pale gold. Maintaining natural skin texture, wet thin hair strands, transparent cloth, window glass, reflected sea light, and branch shadows while realistically layering the person and the scenery in transparent gradations.

Negative:
Do not omit the multiple exposure ocean scenery; do not change the profile to a front-facing view.
